prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A fast guide to spending three days in Lisbon. See the hills, the trams and the river, and taste the city's best-loved food.

beats.narration: Lisbon smells of grilled sardines and sea air. Three days is enough to climb its hills and taste its best bites.

props.alt: tram climbing a hill in a European old town

beats.narration: Day one, wander the old hilltop neighborhoods. Day two, walk the riverside. Day three, head out to the coast and the sea.
Eat custard tarts warm from the oven, grilled fish by the water, and finish every evening with a view.

props.text: Eat warm custard tarts, grilled fish, and sunset views.
